👋 Hire-or-Entity Advisor (unofficial) Tell me a country, an annual gross salary and a team size — I'll show the full employer cost, EOR versus your own entity, and when an entity starts to pay off. Try: Germany 80k 5 people Countries: 🇧🇬 Bulgaria, 🇩🇪 Germany, 🇪🇸 Spain, 🇬🇧 United Kingdom, 🇵🇱 Poland /help — all commands

🇩🇪 Germany · 5 people × €80,000 a year · 12 months EOR (Deel): €526,556 fee €538 per person a month ($599 list price, ECB rate of 28.10.2026) Own entity: €506,527 setup €2,475 + €690 a month + €25 per person a month Salary + contributions, identical either way: €494,273 💡 For 5 people over 12 months your own entity is cheaper by ~€20,029. With 5 people it pays off after 2 months. Direct costs only, each with a source (/sources). Not priced: the weeks an entity takes to set up, your team's time and the compliance risk an EOR carries for you. ⚠️ Deel's guide says long-term care rate: 1.7%; officially from 01.01.2026: 1.8% (source). ⚠️ Deel's guide says insolvency levy: 0.06%; officially from 01.01.2026: 0.15% (source).

With 5 people it pays off after 2 months. Direct costs only, each with a source (/sources). Not priced: the weeks an entity takes to set up, your team's time and the compliance risk an EOR carries for you. ⚠️ Deel's guide says long-term care rate: 1.7%; officially from 01.01.2026: 1.8% (source). ⚠️ Deel's guide says insolvency levy: 0.06%; officially from 01.01.2026: 0.15% (source).

🇧🇬 Bulgaria · €60,000 gross a year Employer cost: €65,222 a year · €5,435 a month On top of salary: +€5,222 a year (8.7%) • State pension 8.22%, capped — €2,269 • Universal pension fund 2.8%, capped — €773 • Sickness and maternity 2.1%, capped — €580 • Unemployment 0.6%, capped — €166 • Health insurance 4.8%, capped — €1,325 • Work accident (IT, office) ~0.4%, capped — €110 2026 rates, in force since 01.01.2026. Payslip lines rounded to the cent, shown in whole units. Contribution ceiling as in force since 01.08.2026, applied to every month. ~ typical rate, depends on the employer. ⚠️ Deel's guide says maximum insurable income: 3,750 BGN/mo; officially from 01.08.2026: €2,300/mo (source).

United Kingdom vs Poland · £50,000 gross a year 🇬🇧 United Kingdom: £58,063 a year · +16.1% EOR £451 a month · entity from 1 person (12 mo) 🇵🇱 Poland: £60,240 a year · +20.5% in PLN: 316,676 zł EOR £451 a month · entity from 2 people (12 mo) 💡 United Kingdom is cheaper to employ in by ~£2,177 a year (3.6% less). Converted at ECB rates of 28.10.2026. ⚠️ Deel's guide says minimum wage: £12.21/h; officially from 01.04.2026: £12.71/h (source). ⚠️ Deel's guide says pension contribution ceiling: 260,190 zł/yr; officially from 01.01.2026: 282,600 zł/yr (source).

🇪🇸 Испания · 3 человека × 50 000 € в год · 24 месяца EOR (Deel): 435 189 € комиссия 538 € за человека в месяц (прайс 599 $, курс ЕЦБ на 28.10.2026) Своё юрлицо: 407 206 € открытие 2 020 € + 319 € в месяц + 15 € за человека в месяц Зарплата + взносы, одинаково в обоих вариантах: 396 450 € 💡 Для 3 человек на 24 месяца своё юрлицо дешевле на ~27 983 €. Для 3 человек оно окупится через 2 месяца. Только прямые расходы, каждая с источником (/sources). Не учтены: недели на открытие юрлица, время вашей команды и комплаенс-риск, который EOR берёт на себя. ⚠️ В гайде Deel минимальная зарплата: 1 262,28 €/мес; официально с 01.01.2026: 1 221 €/мес (источник).
